about.title: About me
about.bio:
Full Stack Developer and Information Systems Engineer (UTN-FRRe) focusing on React, Node.js, and TypeScript.

I developed and deployed a complete web platform for the UTN-FRRe Secretariat of Science and Technology, covering everything from REST API design to UI implementation. Additionally, I was part of the core team behind Elepad, a social impact mobile app published on the Google Play Store.

I am passionate about building efficient solutions using agile methodologies and DevOps culture (Docker, CI/CD, Cloud). I am currently looking to join a team where I can build real products, learn quickly, and add value.

projects.title: Projects
projects.arch_desc: The platform is structured under a decoupled and multi-layered software architecture design, separating presentation logic (React Frontend), business logic and persistence (Node.js/Express Backend with Prisma ORM), and the relational database engine (PostgreSQL). Everything is deployed independently in the cloud.
projects.db_schema_desc: The data modeling was designed following relational normalization principles to ensure referential integrity and optimize complex queries for nested relationships among researchers, projects, agreements, and disbursements.
projects.db_der_desc: Initial conceptual model designed in Draw.io and formally validated with the Secretariat directors to structure data flows and cardinalities.
projects.db_physical_desc: Physical database schema deployed in production using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM, structured with primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and optimized indexes.
projects.devops_arch_desc: The system is designed under a decoupled, containerized microservices architecture. It utilizes Azure Container Instances (ACI) as an independent, elastic host for each component: an interactive Next.js frontend, a high-performance Flask REST API, and a distributed Redis Alpine cache engine, all securely communicating under an internal subnet with persistent cloud storage.
projects.devops_pipeline_desc: The automated workflow is triggered in parallel on every push to the production branch. It runs automated backend tests with Pytest (utilizing a temporary local Redis service) and, upon success, builds optimized multi-stage Docker images and deploys them to Azure Container Instances (ACI) using Azure CLI commands.
projects.devops_parallel_desc: Shows how a single push to the 'docker' branch triggers the execution of both the unit tests and the deployment pipelines in parallel and independently.
projects.devops_success_desc: Summary panel of a successful deployment pipeline run, displaying the triggering commit, the corresponding branch, the success status, and the total execution duration.
projects.devops_detail_desc: Orchestrated sequence of steps inside the CD pipeline: initialization, secure login to Azure ACR, accelerated compilation via Docker Buildx, image push, and dynamic container recreation.
projects.devops_app_desc: Functional views of the deployed web application: the blind voting screen for AI-generated descriptions and the dynamic dashboard with bar charts (using Recharts) displaying model performance statistics stored persistently.
projects.devops_voting_desc: Interactive module where users vote blindly and anonymously on the description that best fits the product.
projects.devops_stats_desc: Dynamic chart displaying the performance and cumulative votes of each AI model in the database.

elepad.title: Elepad — Mobile App for Senior Citizens
elepad.description: Mobile app designed to foster the emotional, cognitive, and social well-being of older adults through an accessible digital environment.
elepad.long_description: Elepad is a mobile application designed to foster the emotional, cognitive, and social well-being of senior citizens through an accessible and interactive digital environment. Through a simplified interface and innovative tools such as AI-powered memory synthesis (Google Gemini), it seeks to build meaningful intergenerational bridges within the family. Originating as a winning proposal at the Latin American Innovation Rally 2024 (3rd place, Social Impact), it evolved into the Final Degree Project for the Information Systems Engineering program (UTN-FRRe). Available on the Google Play Store.
features: Cross-platform mobile development (iOS/Android/Web) using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript
Hyper-scalable Serverless Backend architecture using Cloudflare Workers, Hono, and OpenAPI validation
Comprehensive data management with Supabase: PostgreSQL database, Authentication (Google OAuth), Storage, and Realtime
AI-assisted memory synthesis and narrative album module (Google Gemini)
Monorepo structure managed with Turborepo, optimizing build and development times
Automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions targeting Cloudflare and Expo EAS
Agile development: Team management under the Scrum methodology with 7 documented releases

scyt-utn.title: SCyT Platform — UTN FRRe
scyt-utn.description: Comprehensive web platform for centralizing administrative processes and tracking research projects.
scyt-utn.long_description: I designed and developed the entire comprehensive web platform for the Secretariat of Science and Technology (SCyT) of the National Technological University - Resistencia Regional Faculty (UTN-FRRe). The project was conceived as a strategic solution to address the dispersion of critical information regarding researchers, projects, and agreements (which were previously managed inefficiently across isolated spreadsheets). The system centralizes and unifies all scientific administration within the Faculty, enabling detailed tracking of research projects (both internal PIDs and external), management of teaching and research personnel, and administration of technological linkages, agreements, and financial disbursements. Formally accredited as my Supervised Professional Practice (PPS), I led the complete software development lifecycle: requirements gathering (5W+2H), conceptual analysis, relational database design (ERD), interface prototyping (UX/UI), full-stack development (React, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL), and continuous deployment in a Cloud environment (Render).
features: Design and implementation of the Project Management Module, allowing registration, editing, advanced search, and operational status tracking of scientific projects (internal PIDs and external).
Development of the Researchers & Members Module, enabling the assignment of directors, co-directors, and collaborators with specific roles and historical participation tracking.
Implementation of the Technological Linkages & Agreements Module, facilitating the administration of strategic agreements with external companies and entities (UVT).
Development of a Financial Management & Disbursements Module, enabling the input and tracking of budgets, project funding, and associated fund disbursements.
Development of dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React.js and Chakra UI, achieving an intuitive UX/UI organized into clear tabs and logical blocks.
Multi-layer Backend architecture with Node.js and Express.js, cleanly structured into Routes, Controllers, business logic Services, and Repositories.
Design, normalization, and logical-physical modeling of a relational PostgreSQL database with Prisma ORM, optimizing queries and managing complex nested relations.
Robust authentication and authorization system based on JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with protected routing in the backend.
Essential security practices such as cryptographic password hashing using Bcrypt.
Global state management and asynchronous request optimization using TanStack Query, achieving intelligent caching and reducing server load.
Robust, real-time form validation using React Hook Form integrated with Yup validation schemas.
Version control and collaborative workflow using Git and GitHub, along with continuous deployment (CI/CD) of services and the relational database on Render Cloud.

devops-azure.title: DevOps: Containerization & CI/CD on Azure
devops-azure.description: Web application containerization and CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions for Azure deployment.
devops-azure.long_description: Designed and implemented the containerization architecture and complete CI/CD workflow for SmartCatalog, a microservice-based web application consisting of a modern Next.js frontend (with React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4), a robust Python Flask API backend, and a high-speed caching and storage service with Redis. The project involved designing consistent environments using Docker and Docker Compose for local development, structuring a Continuous Integration (CI) pipeline in GitHub Actions to run automated backend tests with Pytest (utilizing a temporary in-memory Redis service), and configuring a Continuous Deployment (CD) pipeline that automates the multi-stage Docker image build-and-push to Azure Container Registry (ACR) followed by dynamic deployment and orchestration on Azure Container Instances (ACI). This ensures that every push to the deployment branch securely automates the entire software life cycle on the Microsoft Azure cloud.
features: Multi-Service Containerization: Created optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles to build the Next.js (Node.js) frontend and Python Flask backend in isolation, minimizing final image sizes.

Local Orchestration with Docker Compose: Configured a reproducible local environment that links and securely connects the Frontend, Backend, and Redis service using secure passwords and persistence configured via environment variables.

Continuous Integration (CI) with Automated Testing: Developed a GitHub Actions pipeline that installs Python 3.11 dependencies, spins up a local Redis database on the runner, and executes API unit tests using Pytest.
Base Image Fallback Strategy: Automated the CD pipeline to pull, tag, and securely push official external images (such as Redis Alpine) to your private container registry.
Secure Registry with Azure Container Registry (ACR): Configured and authenticated secure Azure credentials in GitHub Actions to store built images safely and privately.
Automated Deployment to Azure Container Instances (ACI): Automated the dynamic creation and recreation of containers in the cloud using Azure CLI commands within GitHub Actions.
Cache Data Persistence: Configured persistent append-only storage (--appendonly yes) and password protection in the production Redis container deployed on the Azure cloud.

Environment Variable and Secret Management: Securely injected production secrets (database credentials, connection URLs, Redis passwords, and Supabase endpoints) at build and execution time without compromising security.
